Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Carrum

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Carrum. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Carrum sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Carrum: What We Commonly See

Carrum sits right on the bay at the mouth of the Patterson River, and that beachside position is hard on roofs. Salt-laden air corrodes metal roofs, ridge capping fixings, valleys and gutters far faster than it does inland. Many of Carrum's post-war and period beach homes now have roofs that have lost their finish and are due for replacement, or early metal roofs now rusting.

The problems we see most in Carrum are rusted gutters and valleys, lifted and cracked ridge capping, and leaks where corroded flashings have failed. Sitting low and close to the water, keeping a roof draining cleanly matters here.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Carrum

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Carrum homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Carrum

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Carrum

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Carrum Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Carrum Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Carrum locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Carrum Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
